notes.text: The linked passage names Rabbi Yochanan ben Arza sitting with Rabbi Yose ben Nehorai over wine. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1832&lang=en) points to the same passage. Hyman abbreviates the title as R’ and the Hebrew notice retains the additional period.
